payout_quote: The person making the referral (Referrer) will earn a $50 Visa Reward Card for each individual or business referred (Referred Person) to M&T Bank who registers for the offer using the Referrer's shared personal referral link, opens a new eligible account and completes all offer requirements.
steps: Be an active M&T Bank customer and register for the M&T Refer Friends program to get your personal referral link.
Share your referral link with friends; they must register for the offer using your link (first referrer whose link is used gets the reward).

Your friend opens a new eligible M&T checking account (personal: MyWay, EZChoice, MyChoice Plus, MyChoice Plus with Interest, MyChoice Premium; business: Business Essential, Business Plus, Business Premium).
For personal checking: your friend makes at least $500 in qualifying direct deposits (payroll, pension, Social Security - no P2P/bank transfers) within 90 days of account opening.
For business checking: your friend completes five deposits of $500+ each, or five business debit/ACH/check/wire transactions of $25+ each, within 90 days.
Your $50 Visa Reward Card is mailed to your registered address 4-6 weeks after all qualifying criteria are met.
catches: The $50 is a Visa Reward Card (MetaBank-issued prepaid), not cash - and it is valid for only three months after issuance.
Friend must be brand new to M&T checking - no primary ownership of any M&T personal or business checking account within the previous six months.
Cap: $500 in referral rewards per calendar year (10 paid referrals).
The friend's direct deposits must be qualifying payroll/pension/Social Security deposits - P2P transfers (Venmo/Zelle etc.) and bank-to-bank transfers do not count.
Reward cards are mailed 4-6 weeks after all criteria are met - not instant.
Rewards cards may be reportable as income for tax purposes.
Offer may vary by product and region; M&T employees ineligible; the referrer must be an active M&T Bank customer.
biggest_catch: The $50 comes as a Visa Reward Card that expires 3 months after issuance - and your friend must be a true newcomer with $500+ in real payroll direct deposits within 90 days.
eligibility: Active M&T Bank customers; referred person must be the primary owner of a new eligible M&T checking account with no M&T checking ownership in the previous 6 months. Not available to California residents or M&T employees.
timing: Visa Reward Card mailed 4-6 weeks after all qualifying criteria have been met.
